title: Five-part trunk (thorax, abdomen, pelvis, 2 shoulders) and limb masses of young fit males
condition: young fit males, personalised anthropometric estimation

source.sample: 30 young fit males; healthy physical-education students (not professional athletes); photographs + circumferences + skinfolds
source.notes: height SD 6.42 cm, body mass SD 7.03 kg.

protocol.summary: Relative masses of body parts including a 5-part trunk for 30 young fit males; comparison with mid-aged/old composite (Table 2).
how_to_use: For a shoulder-separated trunk: thorax 11.99 %, abdomen 14.57 %, pelvis 10.97 %, each shoulder 4.13 % BM (young fit males).
For older/less fit males use the composite: thorax 11.6, abdomen 16.4, pelvis 11.4, shoulder 5.7 % (more abdominal/shoulder fat).
Lower extremity is heavier in young fit males (18.3 % each) than in cadaver-based tables (15.6-16.1 %) – keep consistent whole-body totals.
Estimates are model-based (not direct imaging) – use for robustness checks.

measurement.method: anthropometric estimation (personalised: trunk by Erdmann's CT-derived sub-portion/tissue-density method; limbs by Clauser et al. 1969 regressions)

protocol.notes: Trunk divided into 5 parts: thorax (Tx), abdomen (Ab), pelvis (Pe), right and left shoulder (Sh) – shoulders separated from the thorax (Erdmann 1995/1997). Trunk runs from cervicale to the hip joints (trochanterion/symphysion). Validation: summed body mass 73.75 (7.90) kg vs scale 73.79 (7.15) kg.

data.note: Table 1 prints 1.99 – misprint; 11.99 = 37.53 - 14.57 - 10.97 (Tx+Ab+Pe row) and Table 2 gives 12.0 (rounded)

extraction.from: Table 1 (young fit, mean SD); Table 2 (mid-aged+old composite, 0.1 %)
extraction.uncertainty: none (tabulated); thorax value corrected from sums
extraction.check_notes: Tables are images; re-read at 170 and 400 dpi. Table 1 thorax mean printed 1.99 – inconsistent with Tx+Ab+Pe = 37.53 and Table 2 (12.0); stored 11.99 with printed_value. Whole-body sum with 11.99: 99.94 %. Table 1 also lists Zatsiorsky, Dempster and Clauser literature values (not extracted; secondary).

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
